[SWS_DM_00111] Configurable environment condition checks
⌈
The Di-
agnostic Server instance shall perform a condition check when the ISO 14229-
1[1] mentions a service specific “Condition check” in the defined NRC handling for a
given diagnostic service. The Diagnostic Server instance shall send the con-
figured NRC value (see [SWS_DM_00289]) if the condition is not fulfilled.
⌋
